payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the training sets of ELMo models, indicating that newer models were trained on larger datasets compared to previous versions.

claims.text: The original ELMo model was trained on a one billion word corpus, while newer models for other languages were trained on significantly larger datasets, such as 280 million tokens for Latvian.
ELMoForManyLangs models were trained on only 20 million words, which is significantly smaller than the training sets used for the new ELMo embeddings.
